# matrices.DesignMatrices { #formulae.matrices.DesignMatrices }

```python
matrices.DesignMatrices(model, data, env)
```

A wrapper of the response, the common, and group specific effects.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**model**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Model](`Model`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The model description, the result of calling `model_description`.

<code>[**data**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[pandas](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The data frame where variables are taken from.

<code>[**env**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Environment](`formulae.environment.Environment`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The environment where values and functions are taken from.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

<code>[**response**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ResponseMatrix](`formulae.matrices.ResponseMatrix`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The response in the model. Access its values with `self.response.design_matrix`. It is `None` if there is no response term in the model.

<code>[**common**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[CommonEffectsMatrix](`formulae.matrices.CommonEffectsMatrix`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The common effects (a.k.a. fixed effects) in the model. The design matrix can be accessed with `self.common.design_matrix`. The submatrix for a term is accessed via `self.common[term_name]`. It is `None` if there are no common terms in the model.

<code>[**group**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[GroupEffectsMatrix](`formulae.matrices.GroupEffectsMatrix`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The group specific effects (a.k.a. random effects) in the model. The design matrix can be accessed with `self.group.design_matrix`. The submatrix for a term is accessed via `self.group[term_name]`. It is `None` if there are no group specific terms in the model.
